name: v1.41.0 - Namespaces, ContainsAny improvements, Semi-automatic shard rebalancing, Reranking with decision models
body:
## Breaking Changes

*none*

## Namespaces RF=3 & suspend
*Namespaces add control-plane and data isolation between users on a shared cluster.*

* Namespaces: Add DB.UnloadShard and report which outcome each unload reached by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13186
* Namespaces: Refuse unknown namespace states and add DB.DesiredOpenLocalShardNames by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13241
* Refuse property, class and index changes in a namespace that is not active by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13347
* Answer 422 instead of 500 for a suspended namespace on object endpoints by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13439
* Refuse data requests when a collection's namespace is not active by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13437
* Namespaces: Allow operators to set their own texts for suspended namespaces by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13479
* Retry user creation on any 422 in the Python namespace test setup by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13556
* Namespaces: Add background workers to unload shards by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13538
* Allow a minute for new DB user keys in namespace acceptance tests by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13613
* Namespace: Make supend compatible with drop named vector by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13593
* Refuse aliases from operators that cross namespaces by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13644
* Deny namespaced callers on RBAC paths with an unrecognized shape by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13664
* Enforce the namespace object cap on replicated writes by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13729
* Namespace dynamic user hardening by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13768
* Drop other namespaces from schema, alias and DB user listings by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13750
* Refuse replica movements and hold self-recovery in suspended namespaces by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13653
* Namespaces on multiple home nodes by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13871

## ContainsAny improvements
*ContainsAny operator performance improvements.*

* test(concurrency): count only the goroutines a budget test starts by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13497
* perf(lsmkv): compare keys once per tree level and drop a flatten allocation by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13555
* perf(lsmkv): stop timing segment reads whose duration is never recorded by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13552
* perf(lsmkv): compare NotFound and Deleted directly before errors.Is by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13551
* perf(lsmkv): hash each roaring-set key once for all segments' bloom filters by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13541
* perf(contains): return a nil row for a key the shard does not hold by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13540
* perf(inverted): build batched Contains keys once per filter value by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13554
* perf(lsmkv): inline the strategy checks when the strategy matches by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13539
* fix(slow-log): bound slow-query records for filters with large value lists by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13553

## Advanced API key management

* Add time to live to DB Users by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13422
* Register the DB user expiration gate in TestWLGuards by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13496
* feat(rbac): remove `policy.csv` and rebuild RBAC state from raft by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13638
* Require every verb of a manage permission to see or edit a role by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13790
* Require a wildcard to grant a role pattern that uses regex syntax by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13823
* Rotate user match by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13792
* fix(backups): keep target dynamic-user role assignments on roles-only restores by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13813

## Semi-automatic shard rebalancing (Preview)

* feat(sacr): add the rebalance plan ledger to the replication state machine by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13654
* feat(sacr): add the rebalance planning run and its raft endpoints by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13715
* feat(sacr): add the rebalance measurement endpoint and client by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13739
* feat(sacr): add REST endpoints for the rebalance plan journey by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13800
* feat(sacr): draft shard sizes on each node before a rebalance plan completes by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13887

## Alter Schema - Reindex property (Preview)
*Adds support for changing property's index types.*

* Make runtime reindex and replica movement mutually exclusive by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13049
* reindex: load the double-write state before analyzing a write by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13675
* lsmkv: flush a bucket's unflushed writes before moving it by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13676
* reindex: refuse a filterable-only tokenization change when a searchable index exists by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13674
* distributedtask: hand callbacks the FAILED status a failed ack produced by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13677
* Reindex: report a frozen tenant in ?tenants= as frozen, not missing by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13680
* backup: tell operators how to get past a reindex refusal by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13681
* reindex: log the group's unit count instead of every unit ID by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13684
* dtm: cap the ack error a node writes for many failing units or groups by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13689
* fix(reindex): limit the stale-state sweep to a task's tenants by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13685
* Bound the task-list call in the backup reindex gate by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13683
* backup: share one reindex-gate fetch across a backup instead of one per shard by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13678
* cluster: refuse a reindex submit built against stale replicas by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13699
* backup: report a reindex refusal once per class, not once per shard by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13682
* Reindex: guard migration dir handles, clearer withheld range-index error by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13692
* reindex: refuse submit while any target tenant is not HOT by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13701
* reindex: keep a failed migration's task record until a newer run by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13702
* test: fix two flaky tests (backup fake, overlay swap race check) by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13708
* Bound the distributed task list query when the caller has no deadline by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13706
* reindex: switch the engine to the record and delete markers (part 2/2) by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12848
* test(reindex): wait for each node's /indexes before asserting per-node state by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13742
* reindex: fix two schema-guard godocs that described the wrong race by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13719
* reindex: fix two godocs that stated a contract the code doesn't keep by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13720
* reindex: agree on an unreadable record set whether the shard is loaded or not by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13718
* test(reindex): backup, restore and replica movement after a finished reindex by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13724
* Filter GET /v1/tasks by collection and tenant read by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13709
* reindex: report migration record faults truthfully and keep the folders they may need by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13843
* Start a node with 100k tenants in 6 s instead of 16 min when runtime reindex is enabled by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13799
* reindex: swap each tenant once its own replicas are ready by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13716
* Return an error body with the GET /v1/tasks 403 by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13891
* reindex: speed up shard lookups at 1M tenants from ~45 hours to ~0.02 s per phase by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13874
* reindex: test that a failed reindex can never be reported as finished by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13893
* reindex: remove reindex overhead from tenant loads when no reindex ever ran by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13895
* reindex: fix a write-loss bug when nodes restart mid-reindex by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13755
* reindex: fix reindex failures when a tenant or collection is deleted or deactivated during submit by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13885
* reindex: allow resubmitting a partial reindex without making finished tenants HOT by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13884
* reindex: fix tenant and schema changes stalling during a large reindex (8.7 s to 58 µs at 1M tenants) by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13872

## HFresh
*Extensive improvements including numerous performance optimizations reducing memory usage, disk writes, and allocations.*

* fix(hfresh): allocate posting map migration batch lazily and bound it by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13569
* chore: remove stale hfresh comments, fix schema test by @trengrj in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13727
* Allow hfresh with multi-vector vectorizers; MUVERA implied and required for hfresh multi-vectors (stable/v1.40) by @rlmanrique in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13883
* hfresh: repair postings left without a centroid after a crash by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13915
* hfresh: zero-memory usage for low volume tenants by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13594

## Async replication
*Async replication optimizations and fixes.*

* Fan out dedupe checkpoint planning across classes and expire abandoned checkpoints by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13363
* replication: allow async replication while a node is in maintenance mode by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13869

## Backup reliability improvements

* Read backup objects into one buffer sized from the object length by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13473
* Decode only what incremental backups read from base backup metadata by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13475
* Authorize backup and restore status when the backup metadata is missing by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13679
* backup: tolerate the op unwinding before the cancel flag is read by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13757
* backup: break dedupe designation ties at random by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13794
* backup: lower the dedupe convergence default to 15s and make it configurable by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13796
* Reject backup class and shard names that would escape the data dir by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13788
* Delete a collection's files at once even while a backup runs by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13867
* Speed up object listing by ~50% by decoding properties without reflection by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13898
* Speed up inactive shard backups by ~40% with flat staging folder structure by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13912

## Modules & Integrations

* fix(modules): run rerank before the other additional properties by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13406
* fix(modulecomponents): embed tokenizer vocabularies and stop nil-tokenizer panic by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13558
* feat(text2vec-google): record request duration per service, location and model by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13550
* fix(modules): pick the same module on every request when two provide a property by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13407
* feat(ref2vec-centroid): read referenced vectors from the default named vector by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13842
* Find ref2vec-centroid references in the source object's namespace by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13855
* Rerank: stable sort, request checks for every reranker, text and image clients by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13734
* Rerank: add the reranker-typesafeai module by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13744
* Rerank: add the reranker-openai module by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13770

## Performance & Optimization

* Remove locks from tenant activity by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13146
* Return 500, not 'already exists', when checking an object ID fails by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13472
* queue: replay a failed queue batch on the queue's next turn instead of blocking the workers by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13454
* shard: refuse multi-vector writes on indexes without multi-vector support by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13464
* hnsw: detect bootstrap in entrypoint enhausted scenario by @trengrj in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13480
* Release a shard from the shard status gauge when it is torn down by @byronvoorbach in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13476
* Stop the drop-vector task loading a shard an unload released by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13478
* queue: recover from unreadable and corrupt chunks without leaving them counted by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13487
* Stop schema updates loading a shard an unload released by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13494
* Stop metrics and backup resume loading a shard an unload released by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13502
* queue: fix flaky tests that race the running scheduler by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13504
* perf: improve reindex vector dimensions at startup by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13190
* Skip uncomressed HNSW vector cache if compressor is present by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13508
* Guard the ACORN frontier buffer against overloaded vertices by @rlmanrique in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13533
* compactv2: discard pre-v1.34 snapshots on load instead of failing by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13545
* vector index update: mapping records carry the queue ID and the adopted config by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13537
* Add time to ready, vector index restore and cache prefill metrics (minimal set) by @rlmanrique in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13474
* Wait for the class version before auto-schema adds a property by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13548
* Stop memtable tree recursion from growing the heap profile by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13522
* Keep the vector_index_tombstones gauge equal to the tombstone count by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13549
* chore: disable Claude Code commit and PR attribution by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13599
* hnsw/compact: pin the garbage-node-ID allocation in the raw commit log reader by @rlmanrique in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13341
* test(lazy-load): stop periodic flushes from counting warmup seed objects by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13615
* perf(db): open and walk each shard once for all startup rebuilds before load by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13612
* Whitelist grpc health check reads when operational mode is ReadOnly by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13620
* Make reads wait while this node is still creating a collection by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13557
* Keep vector search distances aligned when an object is missing from the store (backport v1.37) by @rlmanrique in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13650
* rest search: accept a caller-supplied vector on the hybrid endpoint by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13631
* Keep vector search distances aligned when an object is missing from the store (backport v1.38) by @rlmanrique in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13645
* vector index update: drop fields a newer version added to mapping records at shard load by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13711
* vector index update: a mapping record may name a queue other than its index by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13712
* Call MkdirAll once per directory when hardlinking backup files by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13726
* perf(queryadmission): hold each query to the budget its phases actually use by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13617
* Handle EC of collection creation in `TestReplicaMovementOneWriteExtraSlowFileCopy` by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13732
* Add client-side license protocol packages (M4) by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13383
* vector index update: a queue can keep its processed chunks for a second consumer by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13728
* Stop a tenants-only grant from listing a lone collection's schema by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13749
